title: Sebaceous Adenitis
desc: Cyclosporine, Vitamin A, Isotretinoin, Omega-3 fatty acids, Dermoscent Essential 6 Spot-On, Douxo S3 SEB shampoo, Sulfur & salicylic acid shampoo, Baby oil soak, Propylene glycol, Phytosphingosine spray, Hydrating spray

meds.name: Dermoscent Essential 6 Spot-On
meds.doseText: applied to base of neck/shoulder blades in same fashion as flea/tick preventives

meds.name: Baby oil soak
meds.doseText: 50% baby oil, 50% water and saturate coat

meds.name: Propylene glycol
freqs: daily at first, then 2–3 times weekly

meds.name: Hydrating spray
meds.doseText: Hydrating sprays such as Ermidra (ICF), Atop spray (Dermoscent)

notes: Sebaceous Adenitis
Cyclosporine 5 mg/kg SID
Vitamin A: 400 IU/kg daily max 20,000 U per day
Omega-3 fatty acids: Welactin daily
which is about the highest I've been able to find. This would probably be more effective
than feeding a regular diet and supplementing with Welactin.
Consider changing food to Hill's j/d Mobility as it contains 2% DHA & EPA,
Dermoscent Essential 6 Spot-On Large Breed Dog Skin Care Treatment-- available OTC,
basically fatty acids that are applied to base of neck/shoulder blades in same fashion as flea/tick preventives.
Douxo S3 SEB Shampoo: Weekly or as needed.
Labyderm Bioforce® (Labyes).
Hydrating sprays such as Ermidra® (ICF), Atop® spray (Dermoscent),
If needed: Baby oil soaks: 50% baby oil, 50% water and saturate coat. let sit as long as possible 30 to 60 min ideal then degrease in dawn soap bath. then moisturize).
Cyclosporine 5 mg/mkg SID
Isoretinoin 1.5 mg/kg SID -- potentially problematic side effects + high expense, so will hold off for now.
Vitamin A: 400 IU/kg SID with max of 20,000 U SID
Essential fatty acids
Topical treatments:
Sulfer & salicyclic acid shampoos 2-3 times weekly, 10 min contact time
Scale can be removed with soft brushing.
Conditioning shampoos & sprays
Propylene glycol topically-- up to daily, then 2-3 times weekly for maintenance
Phytosphingosine spray
Baby oil soaks (diluted 50:50 with water), leaving on for 1 hr, then washing wiht degreasing sdishwashing soap. Can be repeated weekly or monthly if/as needed.
